Taking damage from enemies grants 5% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. 1 second cooldown between activations.

If a <void/>Void Super Ability is equipped:
Scoring a Kill at Critical Health or 3 Kills within 5 seconds of each grants you <void/>Devour for 5 seconds (7.5 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistance).
